title: JUDICATA: An open, locally deployable pipeline for legal argument support with citation checking in Brazilian law (code, evaluation scripts and stored outputs, PLOS ONE revision)
description: Code, frozen system (tag v2.0.2-frozen), evaluation scripts, synthetic-case generators and stored model outputs for the revised version of the PLOS ONE manuscript PONE-D-26-42993. Every number, table and figure of the manuscript is regenerated from evaluation/results with evaluation/make_numbers.py, make_tables.py and make_figures.py. The external evaluation sets are rebuilt from their public sources with evaluation/build_sets.py and keep their original licences.
